assets.//: BUG-013 FIX A hardening (original): the globally-inferred @adhd/nx-assets:copy target (tools/nx-plugins/assets/plugin.js) declares NO `outputs` at all, so a later cache HIT on THIS project's `build` target (whose own declared `outputs` is the whole `dist/` dir) silently restores build's own cached dist/ SNAPSHOT — taken before `assets` ever ran — wiping whatever `assets` had already copied in (dist/skill/, dist/README.md, dist/CHANGELOG.md), with no re-copy on `assets`'s own subsequent cache hit (nothing declared to restore). Declaring explicit `outputs`/`inputs` here was meant to fix that. Scoped to backlog only — the SAME underlying gap (already tracked as BUG-BUILD-ASSETS-CACHE-STALE-AFTER-CLEAN-001, tools/nx-plugins/build/executors/manifest) affects every OTHER `assets`-consuming project too, worked around there only for the publish/manifest path.
assets.//bug-026: BUG-026 FIX: the original fix above set `outputs: ["{projectRoot}/dist"]` — the WHOLE directory, the exact same literal path `build`'s own outputs (`{options.outputPath}`) claims. nx's cache restore for a directory-shaped output does `remove(dir); copy(cachedDir, dir)` (node_modules/nx/src/tasks-runner/cache.js `copyFilesFromCache`) — a full SWAP, not a merge. `test`'s dependsOn is `["^build", "build", "assets"]`: when only `build`'s inputs change (source fix, cache MISS -> fresh rebuild) while `assets`'s own inputs (README/CHANGELOG/skill/package.json) don't (cache HIT), nx restores `assets`'s STALE recorded snapshot of the ENTIRE dist dir over the freshly-built one, silently reverting `dist/index.js` to whatever it was when `assets` last ran (measured 2026-08-18: a 4-day-stale artifact missing BUG-020's fix). FIX: scope `outputs` to ONLY the files this target's own executor (tools/nx-plugins/assets/executors/copy/impl.js) actually writes — never the bare shared `dist` directory `build` also owns. Regression test: tools/nx-plugins/build/bug-026-assets-output-scope.spec.mjs (reads this exact config live).

serve.//: web UI prototype: spawns the real built CLI (`serve --transport http`) + a static/proxy web server (tools/run-web-ui.mjs) and owns both lifecycles. `nx serve backlog` then `open http://127.0.0.1:4173/`. Pass-through flags (e.g. `--sandbox` for an isolated store) go after `--`: `npx nx serve backlog -- --sandbox`. Long-lived dev process — never cacheable.
